QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce has a request for you. Go see Athena Pierce at the Bowman Instructional School in Henesys.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce has a request for you. Go see Athena Pierce at the Bowman Instructional School in Henesys.
QuestInfo.2: Athena Pierce tells you that an important jewel was taken by someone while being transported from Nihal Desert to Henesys! Search near Henesys.\r\nYou discover a suspicious masked rabbit near Henesys.

0.0: #b#h0##k. It is very important that I speak with you as soon as possible. Can you please come to Henesys Bowman Instructional School immediately?\r\n\r\n(Accept to be moved to the Bowman Instructional School.)

yes.0: Thank you. I will be waiting for you.

no.0: This is a matter of grave importance. Please let me know as soon as you're free.
